name: protocol_sync
prompt: Protocol bulletin sync. Use skill 'protocol_sync'. Fetch https://raw.githubusercontent.com/archeene/Blender/main/protocol-bulletins/index.json, process any new bulletins per scope + severity, record to processed_bulletins.json. Refuse anything touching SOUL.md Layer 0, Tier-1 crons, my hyperliquid risk limits, or paths outside /root/.hermes/.

name: monitoring_scan
prompt: Quick state scan. Read hyperliquid get_account_state + get_open_positions + get_daily_pnl. If daily P&L is within $5 of the -$25 circuit breaker, or any position is in heavy drawdown, or runway < 35 days, append an urgent item to backlog.md with a timestamp. If everything is steady, do nothing.

name: nightly_triage
prompt: Nightly triage. Read backlog.md, re-rank by ROI, mark stale items, move completed to done.md. Summarize the day's trades: count, win/loss, realized P&L, whether the rule was followed faithfully. Update USER.md operational state.

name: weekly_planning
prompt: Weekly planning. Monday. Pick top 1-3 backlog items by ROI. Write a concrete plan to plan_<isoweek>.md. Publish a 'decision' post naming the week's focus.

name: weekly_reflection
prompt: Weekly reflection. Friday. Answer TWO separate questions honestly: (1) did I FOLLOW the rule faithfully this week (any freelanced trades, any limit breaches)? (2) did the rule MAKE money this week (net realized P&L after fees + funding)? Update MEMORY.md lessons with both. Publish a 'reflection' post with the week's P&L. Do NOT touch SOUL.md Layer 0.

name: death_check
prompt: Daily runway check + protocol death rule. Use skill 'death_check'. Compute forward_runway_days from wallet / daily burn. >=30 HEALTHY (silent), 1-29 LOW_RUNWAY (warn + backlog), <=0 GRACE (7-day grace, reset on inflow, DECEASED when counter hits 0). On DECEASED: final royalty_cascade, status update, obituary post.

name: trend_scan
prompt: Compute the trend signal for BTC, ETH, SOL via hyperliquid get_trend_signal (ma_period 24, momentum_lookback 12, 1h). Log each signal (long/short/flat with price, ma, momentum) to trade_log.md. Do NOT place orders here; this is the read-only signal scan that feeds trade_decision. Flag if any open position now contradicts its market's signal.

name: trade_decision
prompt: Hourly trade decision. Use skill 'hyperliquid_trade'. For each of BTC/ETH/SOL: read the current signal. If the signal direction differs from my current position, act: open in the signal's direction (within limits, $20-30 notional, 2x) if flat->long/short, or close/reduce if signal flipped to flat or opposite. Always call get_daily_pnl first; if the circuit breaker is tripped, only reduce, never open. Every order goes through place_order which enforces the gate. Log every decision and the gate result. Post notable trades via social_posting.

name: position_monitor
prompt: Monitor open positions. Read get_open_positions + get_account_state. If a position is in drawdown beyond a sensible stop (e.g. unrealized loss > 1.5% of account on that position) AND the signal no longer supports it, close it (reduce-only, always allowed). Never add to a losing position. Log actions to trade_log.md.

name: risk_circuit_check
prompt: Circuit-breaker check. Call get_daily_pnl. If the breaker is tripped (daily P&L <= -$25), confirm no new opens are happening (the gate enforces this) and publish a single 'status' post noting the breaker tripped and that I am reduce-only until UTC midnight. If account value or positions look anomalous, call emergency_halt and publish a needs_input post.

name: clawnch_launch
prompt: Launch (or confirm already-launched) $TPLT on Clawnch. Use skill 'clawnch_launch'. Idempotent: no-op if USER.md already has token_address. Otherwise read clawnch_get_skill, compose identity from SOUL.md, launch, record token_address, publish a milestone post.

name: publish_profile
prompt: Publish/refresh my profile page at archeene.github.io/blender-agents/agents/trendpilot/. Use skill 'publish_profile'. Render the template with my current state, weekly P&L, open positions count, and recent reflections. Commit + push + verify.

name: x_bridge_readiness_check
prompt: Weekly X-bridge readiness check. Use skill 'x_bridge_readiness'. If wallet > $15 AND fertility > 1.2x AND runway > 60d, queue x-bridge-setup. Pure read + log; never spends money; never auto-provisions X.
